text: You pay for Claude every month. Most of the day, it sits idle.
Someone else needs that exact capacity, and has to buy a whole plan to get it.
With Kazuo, one command turns your subscription into a provider node, selling work one job at a time.
A buyer describes the work. The network answers with a four oh two, and exactly what it costs. Nothing is paid yet.
The buyer signs one USDC authorization. It settles on Arc, straight to the provider, and the facilitator pays the gas.
Every job leaves a receipt in the Kazuo Log contract on Arc testnet. The payment, the provider, and a hash of the result.
Providers prove they are human with World ID. People sign in with Privy, and AI agents buy over MCP.
Kazuo. Idle AI subscriptions, turned into income, on Arc.
